title: ForeGuard: code, checkpoints and results for the forecast-guarded rerouting study
description: Simulator, training and evaluation code, trained checkpoints and raw results for the paper 'ForeGuard' (forecast-driven, capacity-guarded rerouting in a k=4 Fat-Tree), including the host-buffer rerun of the Table V benchmark (Table A14).
